MISSION GUIDELINES & CONTROLS

1. Movement & Waypoints
Use W A S D or Arrow Keys to walk, or click any floor tile to walk automatically.
E
2. Consoles, Tools & Crew
Walk near any glowing machine or crew member and press E (or tap the prompt) to operate mini-games and chat!
3. Airlock & EVA Spacesuit
Cycle the rotary pressure dial to 101.3 kPa before opening the outer Martian hatch! Returning inside safely stows your suit.
4. 3 Hearts & Timers
Protect your 3 Hearts! Keep battery charge and air clean, and beat crisis countdown bars before time runs out.
